disclaimer: Layout based on Tambaram station data pack (Oct 2026). Distances and positions are estimated. Lift/escalator statuses as reported 11 Oct 2026 — verify on site before use.

lift.name: Lifts — Old FOB (Platforms 1–10)
lift.status_note: Platform lifts awaiting licence/installation (Oct 2026). West-entry lifts licensed but approach incomplete.
directions_en: From kiosk, walk along the west concourse toward the overbridge stairs
Follow signs to the Old Foot Over Bridge (FOB)
Lifts are at each platform pair — check status board before use
West-entry lifts (GST Road side) are licensed but approach paths are still being completed

escalator.name: Escalators — Old FOB (West & East entrances)
escalator.status_note: Old FOB escalators at west and east entrances are open. New FOB escalators under construction.
directions_en: From kiosk, walk toward the Old Foot Over Bridge
Escalators are at the west entrance (GST Road) and east entrance (Velachery Road) ends of the old FOB
New FOB escalators at platform level are under construction (expected Dec 2026)

washroom.name: Washrooms (West & East concourse)
washroom.status_note: Positions are estimated — verify on site.
directions_en: West washroom: near the west concourse (GST Road side)
East washroom: near the east entrance (Velachery Road side)
Ask station staff if positions are unclear

exit.name: Main Entrance / Exit (West — GST Road)
directions_en: Walk straight through the west concourse
Main entrance / exit is on GST Road
East entrance: on Velachery Road opposite MCC College
